notes: A much simpler view: related pages are now COMBINED into single tabs. Practice went from 12 tabs to 5 — Instrument (Neck / Tab / Notation / Keys), Theory (Chords / Circle), Play (Songs / Jam), Practice (Trainer / Woodshed), Tools (Metronome / Tuner) — and the Studio from 5 to 3 — Sketch (Song / Ideas), Tracks (Loop / Arrange), Pads. Pick a tab from the menu, then flip between its views with the pill strip under the top bar; every group remembers which view you used last. Nothing was removed — every page, shortcut and cross-link works exactly as before, just with far less menu noise.
